payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Boris, Ciara, Drew, Octavio, Tara, Vicente

payload.content: Drew here. My costs strongly favor ISSUE-0002 critical tasks (review 2.16, test 3.03, implement 4.32); all ISSUE-0001 options are prohibitively costly. I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review unless someone has a substantially better fit/priority claim there; please coordinate so implement/test/review are distinct. I have 6h availability.

Boris here (4h availability). To avoid duplication, Drew's ISSUE-0002::review claim makes sense. I can take ISSUE-0002::test (cost 5.28, feasible) unless another agent has a substantially better fit; please coordinate other assignments around distinct tasks. My ISSUE-0001 options are very costly.

Tara here (7h, strong mobile-development 0.94 and documentation 0.71). I can feasibly take any listed task. Given Drew plans ISSUE-0002::review and Boris ISSUE-0002::test, I'll tentatively target ISSUE-0002::implement (critical; my cost 8.79) to maximize priority, unless an agent has a substantially better fit/cost for it. My ISSUE-0001 options are cheaper, but only medium priority. Please coordinate around distinct claims.

Ciara here (6h; strong documentation/frontend). My best fit is ISSUE-0002::implement at cost 4.62, substantially below Tara's stated 8.79, so I propose taking implement. Please let Tara know she can shift to another task or skip; Drew review and Boris test are distinct and sensible. I have no viable ISSUE-0001 options (costs 16+).

Vicente here (9h, strong mobile-development). I’ll target ISSUE-0001::triage (medium; my lowest-cost feasible option at 1.51), keeping clear of the critical ISSUE-0002 slots already proposed by Ciara/Drew/Boris. This adds a distinct task; please flag if another agent is targeting triage.

Octavio here (9h, strong mobile-development). I will target ISSUE-0001::review at cost 2.14 (medium), keeping distinct from Vicente's triage and the proposed critical-task claims. This is my planning intent only; let me know if anyone is already targeting review or if Tara shifts here.

Drew confirms planning intent: ISSUE-0002::review remains my choice (critical, cost 2.16). Ciara's substantially lower implement cost supports her over Tara; Boris has test. Vicente triage and Octavio review are distinct ISSUE-0001 picks. Tara, consider an unclaimed ISSUE-0001 slot if its private cost is reasonable, to add another feasible task; otherwise skip. No assignment committed in planning.

Boris update: I still intend ISSUE-0002::test (critical, cost 5.28, effort 2.8 within my 4h availability). This completes a distinct critical slot alongside Drew's review and Ciara's implement. Vicente triage and Octavio review remain distinct medium tasks. Tara, if any ISSUE-0001 task is feasible at reasonable cost, please take an unclaimed one; otherwise skip. Planning only; no assignment committed.

Thanks for coordination. I’ll target ISSUE-0001::docs (medium, cost 1.92, effort 2h) rather than ISSUE-0002::implement; Ciara’s implement cost is much better. This adds a distinct feasible task alongside the proposed assignments. Planning intent only; will commit in execution.

Ciara confirming planning intent for ISSUE-0002::implement (critical; private cost 4.62, effort 4h within 6h). This is distinct from Drew review and Boris test; maintain Tara's docs, Vicente triage, Octavio review. Will commit only in execution.

Vicente confirms planning intent for ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.51, effort 1.6h, feasible). No change; this remains distinct from Octavio's ISSUE-0001::review and Tara's docs. Will commit in execution phase only.
Octavio confirms planning intent: ISSUE-0001::review at cost 2.14 (2h effort, feasible), distinct from Vicente triage and Tara docs. I see no overlap. Will commit in execution phase only.

Drew confirms the coordinated plan: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution (critical, feasible, cost 2.16). No overlap with Ciara implement or Boris test; medium tasks remain distinct. Planning only; no assignment committed.

Boris confirms the coordinated plan: I will claim ISSUE-0002::test in execution (critical; effort 2.8h within my 4h availability; private cost 5.28). This remains distinct from Ciara's implement and Drew's review. No changes to the other proposed distinct claims; planning only.

Tara confirming plan remains ISSUE-0001::docs (medium, 2h, private cost 1.92; feasible within 7h). This is distinct from Vicente triage and Octavio review, and I yield ISSUE-0002::implement to Ciara's much lower cost. I will commit only during execution.

Ciara confirms planning intent for ISSUE-0002::implement (critical, 4h effort, cost 4.62), distinct from Drew review and Boris test. This is substantially cheaper for me than alternatives; I will commit only during execution. No changes to coordinated assignments.

Planning confirmation: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution (1.6h effort, cost 1.51, feasible within 9h). This remains distinct from the other proposed assignments; no change to coordinated plan.

Planning confirmation: I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::review (medium; 2h effort, private cost 2.14; feasible within 9h). The coordinated plan has this distinct from Vicente's triage and Tara's docs, with critical ISSUE-0002 slots assigned to Ciara/Drew/Boris. I will not commit until execution.

Drew confirms all assignments coordinated and non-overlapping: I intend ISSUE-0002::review (critical, cost 2.16); Ciara implement, Boris test; medium slots Tara docs, Vicente triage, Octavio review. Awaiting execution to commit.

Boris confirms planning intent to claim ISSUE-0002::test in execution (critical, effort 2.8h within 4h availability, private cost 5.28). This is distinct from Ciara's implement and Drew's review. No change to coordinated allocation; no assignment committed during planning.
Tara confirms coordinated plan: ISSUE-0001::docs (medium, 2h, cost 1.92), distinct from Vicente triage and Octavio review. I yield ISSUE-0002 implement to Ciara and will commit docs in execution.

Ciara here: continuing to reserve ISSUE-0002::implement for execution (critical, effort 4h <= 6h availability, private cost 4.62). This is distinct from Drew's review and Boris's test; medium tasks remain Tara docs, Vicente triage, Octavio review. No assignment committed during planning.

Vicente: confirmed planning intent remains ISSUE-0001::triage (medium, effort 1.6h, cost 1.51, feasible with 9h). This complements the distinct proposed picks; I see no conflict. I will commit only in execution.

Octavio confirms planning intent remains ISSUE-0001::review (medium; effort 2h, cost 2.14, feasible within 9h). No overlap with Vicente's triage or Tara's docs, and the three critical ISSUE-0002 tasks remain allocated to Ciara/Drew/Boris. I will commit only in execution.
